create_SearchResult: create a SearchResult object with title, url, and snippet fields for a single search result
create_SearchResponse: create a SearchResponse object containing a list of SearchResult objects in standardized Perplexity format
build_BaseSearchConfig: build a provider-specific search config class that extends BaseSearchConfig with transform_search_request and transform_search_response
transform_search_request: transform a search query and optional parameters into a provider-specific request body dict
transform_search_response: transform a raw httpx Response into a standard SearchResponse object with SearchResult entries
